entries.title: II Samuel 7:1
segments: And it happened when the king dwelt in his house, and when the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:2
segments: the king said to Nathan the prophet, See now, I live in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells within curtains.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:3
segments: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that [is] in your heart, for the LORD [is] with you.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:4
segments: And that night the word of the LORD came to Nathan saying,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:5
segments: Go and tell My servant David, So says the LORD, Shall you build Me a house for My dwelling?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:6
segments: For I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up the sons out of Egypt until this day, but have walked in a tent, even in a tabernacle.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:7
segments: In all [places] in which I have walked with all the sons of Israel, did I speak a word with any of the tribes of Israel, [those] I commanded to feed My people Israel, saying, Why do you not build Me a house of cedars?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:8
segments: And now so shall you say to My servant David, So says the LORD of hosts: I took you from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people, over Israel.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:9
segments: And I was with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies out of your sight, and have made you a great name like the name of the great ones in the earth.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:10
segments: And I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more. Neither shall the sons of wickedness afflict them any more, as before.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:11
segments: And even from the time that I commanded judges [to be] over My people of Israel, so will I cause you to rest from all your enemies. Also the LORD tells you that He will make you a house.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:12
segments: And when your days [are] fulfilled, and you shall sleep with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, who shall come out of your bowels. And I will make his kingdom sure.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:13
segments: He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:14
segments: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the sons of men.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:15
segments: But My mercy shall not leave him, as I took [it] from Saul, whom I put away before you.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:16
segments: And your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before you. Your throne [shall be] established forever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:17
segments: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:18
segments: Then king David went in and sat before the LORD. And he said, Who [am] I, O Lord Jehovah? And what [is] my house, that You have brought me here?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:19
segments: And this was yet a small thing in Your sight, O Lord God. But You have spoken also of Your servant's house for a great while to come. And [is] this the manner of men, O Lord God?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:20
segments: And what can David say more to You? For You, O Lord Jehovah, know Your servant.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:21
segments: For Your word's sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all these great things to make Your servant know.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:22
segments: Therefore You are great, O LORD God. For there is none like You, neither is there any God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:23
segments: And what one nation in the earth [is] like Your people, like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to Himself, and to make Him a name, and to do for You great things and terrible, for Your land, before Your people, whom You redeemed to You from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:24
segments: For You have confirmed to Yourself Your people Israel [to be] a people to You forever. And You, LORD, have become their God.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:25
segments: And now, O LORD God, the word that You have spoken concerning Your servant, and concerning his house: establish [it] forever, and do as You have said.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:26
segments: And let Your name be magnified forever, saying, The LORD of hosts [is] the God over Israel. And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:27
segments: For You, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, have revealed to Your servant, saying, I will build you a house. Therefore Your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to You.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:28
segments: And now, O Lord Jehovah, You [are] that God, and Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:29
segments: Therefore, now, let it please You to bless the house of Your servant, to be forever before You. For You, O Lord GOD, have spoken. And with Your blessing let the house of Your servant be blessed forever.
